headline: IIO Investigates Incident in Williams Lake That Seriously Injured Woman
summary: The Independent Investigations Office of BC is investigating a May 8, 2026, incident in a Williams Lake municipal park. A woman sustained serious but non-life-threatening injuries during an interaction with an RCMP officer who was called after she interacted with bylaw officers and city staff. The IIO was notified of the event on July 3 by the Police Accountability Unit of the BC First Nations Justice Council. Investigators are now asking witnesses or anyone with video of the incident to contact the IIO Witness Line or submit a form online.

source.title: IIO investigating Williams Lake incident that left woman seriously injured
